app_store.promotional_text: Discover tailored shirts, premium polos, and modern heritage apparel crafted in Bangladesh. Free shipping over ৳3,000 and Cash on Delivery nationwide.
app_store.description:
ANGKON is the House of Modern Heritage — reimagining contemporary Bangladeshi apparel with enduring artisanal tailoring, breathable fabrics, and refined silhouettes.

Key Highlights:
- Modern Heritage Drops: Structured shirts, polos, and tailored bottoms designed for everyday distinction.
- Artisanal Craftsmanship: Breathable 100% combed cottons and reinforced seams built to last beyond fast-fashion cycles.
- Nationwide Doorstep Delivery: 2-3 days delivery inside Dhaka and reliable shipping across all 64 districts.
- Cash on Delivery & Free Exchanges: Seamless shopping with full support and effortless 7-day size swaps.
- Flagship Showroom: Visit our physical boutique in Niketan, Gulshan, Dhaka.
